Definition
[Regular and singular times of a surgery space-time] ↗ def:surgery-space-time ↗ def:compatible-with-time-vector-field

A time $t$ is regular if some neighborhood $J\subset I$ of $t$ admits a compatible diffeomorphism $M_t\times J\to {\bf t}^{-1}(J)$. Otherwise it is singular. If every time is regular, the space-time is the product $M_t\times I$ with product time and vector field.
